quotes: loved this bts video! i think the animation team probably has the most difficult job as they also have to consider the wipeout frame and for most of them to look appealing. i just got remielle and she’s one of the most fun agents for me! her main ult with the ether cannon in combo with her other ults is satisfying especially in the stun window!

seriously, props to everyone in the team for their hard work in the game. it's really great to put faces on different part of the team. again, congrats for 2nd anniversary of zzz. keep up the amazing work, and take care of yourself.

was a major letdown considering that it was a void hunter patch. the only really good thing were the cake scene. remielle is so cryptic all the time that her earning our trust felt weird not to mention the wet wings part...

quotes: while i do love the current character designs and outfits we are getting. please consider hiring a fashion designer to help design some of the clothing characters wear in the future. some of it has gotten a bit repetitive when it comes to style and it gets kinda boring to see. again, they aren't bad. but more unique outfits that aren't similar all the time would be nice to have. gameplay wise, you guys are cooking so hard. it really feels like you wanted to make a proper fighting game/hack and slash game and are passionate about it. i love zzz.
